title: Hard-Water Calcium Carbonate Precipitation
learningGoal: Precipitate the calcium in a hard-water sample completely: add the carbonate in portions while stirring, then test that no more precipitate forms.

nodes.title: Stand the rod in the beaker
nodes.description: Stand the glass stirring rod in the beaker of hard-water sample, ready to stir.

feedback.success: Stand the rod in the beaker complete.
feedback.retry: Review Stand the rod in the beaker and try again.

nodes.title: Add the first portion (1 of 3)
nodes.description: Pour a third of the {{config.reagentVolumeMl}} mL of sodium carbonate solution into the beaker while you stir with the rod.

feedback.success: Add the first portion (1 of 3) complete.
feedback.retry: Review Add the first portion (1 of 3) and try again.

nodes.title: Record what you see
nodes.description: Look at the mixture and record what forms.

feedback.success: Record what you see complete.
feedback.retry: Review Record what you see and try again.

nodes.title: Add the second portion (2 of 3)
nodes.description: Pour the next third in while you stir.

feedback.success: Add the second portion (2 of 3) complete.
feedback.retry: Review Add the second portion (2 of 3) and try again.

nodes.title: Add the last portion (3 of 3)
nodes.description: Pour in the last third while you stir. Keep what is left in the working beaker for the test at the end.

feedback.success: Add the last portion (3 of 3) complete.
feedback.retry: Review Add the last portion (3 of 3) and try again.

nodes.title: Keep stirring
nodes.description: Keep stirring the mixture for another couple of minutes.

feedback.success: Keep stirring complete.
feedback.retry: Review Keep stirring and try again.

nodes.title: Rinse the rod
nodes.description: Lift the rod a little and rinse it down into the beaker with a squirt from the wash bottle, so the solid on it stays in the beaker.

feedback.success: Rinse the rod complete.
feedback.retry: Review Rinse the rod and try again.

nodes.title: Lift the rod out
nodes.description: Lift the rinsed rod out and lay it on the bench.

feedback.success: Lift the rod out complete.
feedback.retry: Review Lift the rod out and try again.

nodes.title: Let it settle
nodes.description: Leave the beaker still until the white solid has settled and the liquid above it is clear.

feedback.success: Let it settle complete.
feedback.retry: Review Let it settle and try again.

nodes.title: Fill a dropping pipette
nodes.description: Draw a little of the sodium carbonate solution into the dropping pipette.

feedback.success: Fill a dropping pipette complete.
feedback.retry: Review Fill a dropping pipette and try again.

nodes.title: Test that it is complete
nodes.description: Add one drop of the solution to the clear liquid above the solid and look closely. No new cloudiness means all the calcium has precipitated.

validation.label: Test that it is complete was completed.

feedback.success: Test that it is complete complete.
feedback.retry: Review Test that it is complete and try again.
